# Tile Bloom

> Tile Bloom is a calm rotation puzzle made from Vietnamese gạch bông cement tiles, for iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later), Android and web browsers. Tap a tile to turn it; when all the corners that meet at a point match, a flower blooms there. Make every meeting point bloom to finish the floor. The App Store and Google Play versions are coming soon; Chapter I and the daily tile can be played now in the browser.

- 84 levels in seven chapters, the rooms of a Vietnamese tube house: The Porch, The Living Room, The Courtyard, The Kitchen, The Stairwell, The Balcony and The Rooftop. Boards grow from 2×2 to 7×8.
- A daily tile: one new floor every day, the same for everyone, with a day streak and a plain-text result to share.
- Six motifs, each with its own colour and shape, so a match never depends on colour alone. Undo, three hints per floor, light and dark themes, assist mode, keyboard control on desktop.
- Chapter I and the daily tile are free. One in-app purchase opens every chapter after the first, for good. No subscription.
- The app works offline. No ads, no account, no analytics or tracking. Progress is stored only on the device. The game is in English.
